baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins eating, fruit, deliberate work, hands, and the closing question about gratitude.
baseline_models.mechanism: Consumable yield arrives at the eater through a productive process that deliberate handwork does not fully originate. Gratitude is the recognition that use and benefit exceed the eater's fabrication.

activation_trace.role: Direct consumption supplies the endpoint at which the productive gift becomes bodily benefit.
Mature tree-yield supplies the produced object whose arrival is being attributed.
Intentional action supplies the human causal contribution against which origination is measured.
Attribution of deeds to the hands makes human agency emphatic rather than merely instrumental.
Recognition of favor supplies the demanded response to correctly attributed benefit.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply asks people to give thanks for food.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks eaters to distinguish using a yield from originating its productivity, and to answer that distinction with gratitude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The work-of-hands clause can be heard alongside, rather than only in negation of, the fruit that is eaten.
baseline_models.mechanism: If the clause is heard relatively, the meal includes both unprocessed yield and transformations made by skilled hands. Human craft remains real, but gratitude locates craft inside a prior field of supplied materials and capacities.

activation_trace.role: Generated benefit broadens fruit from a raw object to an outcome available for further use.
Manual workers supply a concrete image of hands converting available material into usable food.
Artisanal skill makes the hands genuine contributors without making them the source of the whole productive order.
Acknowledged favor prevents skilled processing from becoming a claim of self-sufficient production.

changed_reading.before: Human making and divine gift must be mutually exclusive readings of the clause.
changed_reading.after: The clause can preserve human processing while placing its materials, powers, and successful yield within a gift that still calls for gratitude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Eating is followed immediately by a question using the root whose branches include nourishment becoming visibly productive.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gratitude can be more than verbal acknowledgment: as slight feed becomes visible flourishing and fresh growth, received fruit should become a manifested good in the recipient.

activation_trace.role: An allotted edible provision supplies the small input received by the beneficiary.
Fruit as generated benefit supplies the outcome that can be reproduced in conduct.
A little nourishment producing a visible effect makes gratitude a responsive amplification of what was received.
Fresh offshoots supply a plant image for benefit becoming new outward growth.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is an inward feeling or spoken acknowledgment after eating.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is also the visible fruiting of provision in the recipient, where nourishment issues in further good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context expands fruit into a chain: inert earth is revived, hidden grain emerges, a germinating seed bears, and water bursts from flowing sources. Human hands may cultivate within this chain, but the focus denies them exclusive title to its upstream transitions.

activation_trace.role: Mature yield anchors the context chain back in the focus object that is eaten.
Emphatic hand-attribution marks the human claim whose causal scope the chain limits.
Lifeless land supplies the unproductive starting state before any edible return exists.
Earth revived through rain and vegetation supplies the first nonhuman transition toward yield.
Drawing something out of concealment makes grain an emergence, not a hand-assembled object.
The germinating, grain-bearing seed supplies a self-unfolding material link in the chain.
Wide splitting and outflow supply the enabling release of water into the planted system.
A flowing water source supplies the continuing input that hands neither fabricate nor contain.

structural_cues: Verses 36:33-35 form one contiguous movement from dead earth through grain and irrigated gardens to eating and gratitude.
The upstream transitions are stated before the focus contrasts them with human hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered states of land, life, emergence, seed, and water; I infer a causal arrow from those states to fruit. Human cultivation remains a live intermediate cause, but not the origin of the chain.

changed_reading.before: Fruit is a finished gift placed opposite human manufacture.
changed_reading.after: Fruit is the visible endpoint of a layered living system, so gratitude concerns dependence on upstream transitions even when hands genuinely cultivate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following verse places what earth grows among created pairings and unknown kinds. The fruit in the focus becomes the visible surface of relational and partly unknown generativity, while hand skill occupies only the observable final layer.

activation_trace.role: Generated benefit anchors the model in fruit as an outcome rather than an isolated object.
Skilled hands supply the visible human layer whose explanatory reach is being bounded.
Originary bringing-into-being supplies a category larger than artisanal transformation.
Joined counterparts supply a relational mechanism by which outcomes arise from more than one visible agent.
Vegetation issuing from earth ties created relationality directly back to the focus fruit.

structural_cues: Verse 36:36 immediately follows the focus and extends its agricultural scene to pairs, selves, and unknown kinds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created pairs, earth-growth, and unknown kinds; I infer that paired and hidden relations help explain the focus yield. The alternative is that the verse catalogs creation without specifying a growth mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The hand clause corrects a simple mistake about who made a visible fruit.
changed_reading.after: The hand clause also demands epistemic modesty: the visible yield condenses relations and unknown processes that skilled handling cannot exhaustively explain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ship-and-riding sequence treats an artifact-like utility as carried, created, vulnerable to drowning, and preserved only as mercy and temporary use. By analogy, hand-processed food can be genuinely useful without becoming self-securing or self-originating.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful work anchors the analogy in real human making and use.
Artisanal hands make the focus compatible with an artifact-like comparison.
Bearing a visible load supplies the enabling function on which passengers depend.
The waterborne vessel supplies the artifact-like object through which utility is mediated.
A filled load makes the vessel's successful capacity concrete rather than merely symbolic.
Originary creation places rideable utility inside supplied possibility.
Actual riding supplies the beneficiary's use, parallel to eating in the focus.
Drowning in water exposes the utility's inability to guarantee its own success.
Merciful preservation supplies the condition under which a made utility continues to benefit.
A useful means for present needs makes enjoyment derivative and time-bounded.

structural_cues: The ship sequence follows the agricultural signs and repeats the pattern of created provision becoming human use.
Use is immediately paired with the possibility of failure and with mercy as preservation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies carrying, riding, drowning, mercy, and temporary use; I transfer that dependency pattern to hand-processed fruit. The live alternative is that transport illustrates only rescue, not the causal status of artifacts.

changed_reading.before: Once hands process a resource, their successful product is straightforwardly theirs.
changed_reading.after: Even a hand-mediated utility remains dependent on supplied capacities, favorable conditions, and preservation; successful use does not establish originary authorship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command to spend from allotted provision, and the refusal to feed on the ground that God could feed directly, block a quietist reading of the focus. Recognizing nonhuman origination must activate human distribution rather than cancel it.

activation_trace.role: Hands as emphatic agents anchor the question of what human agency should do with received yield.
Acknowledging the giver supplies the response that the distribution scene turns into action.
Wealth going out in expenditure supplies the required movement of provision beyond its holder.
An allotted gift frames what is held as received distribution rather than absolute possession.
Feeding another supplies the human mediation that the objectors wrongly oppose to divine provision.

structural_cues: Verse 36:47 converts the surah's food-provision language into a command and records a refusal based on a false either-or between divine and human feeding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received provision, commanded expenditure, and a refusal to feed; I infer that this scene specifies an enacted form of the focus gratitude. The alternative is that it addresses charity independently, but its feeding logic directly tests the same agency distinction.

changed_reading.before: Because hands did not originate the fruit, their proper role is only to acknowledge its giver.
changed_reading.after: Because the fruit is received provision, grateful hands must also circulate it; divine origination intensifies rather than erases human responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Work is later repaid, and hands themselves speak while limbs testify to earnings. The focus therefore distinguishes originary agricultural productivity from moral authorship; it does not dissolve human action into passivity.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work anchors the model in action for which a person can remain responsible.
Deeds emphatically attributed to hands create the focus point later turned into testimony.
Action answered by equivalent recompense supplies a strict consequence for human work.
The repeated intentional-work branch confirms that human acts remain genuinely attributable.
Intelligible speech turns the bodily instrument of action into an evidentiary voice.
The same hand-attribution now functions as direct testimony about its owner's deeds.
Informed declaration supplies the legal mechanism by which embodied action is disclosed.
Seeking and obtaining benefit names the acquisitive activity for which the hands bear witness.

structural_cues: Verse 36:54 makes work the basis of recompense.
Verse 36:65 reuses hands as speaking evidence of what people acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompensed work and bodily testimony; I infer a distinction between originating natural yield and authoring accountable choices. The narrower alternative is that the focus negation concerns only this crop, but the later echoes still prevent a general denial of agency.

changed_reading.before: The denial of hand-making minimizes human agency in general.
changed_reading.after: The denial is jurisdictional: hands do not originate the living yield, yet they fully own the moral direction, acquisition, and distribution of their acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later cattle sequence deliberately reassembles creation, work, hands, ownership, facilitated use, eating, benefits, drinking, and the same gratitude question. Human possession and use are affirmed, but they sit beneath a higher making and finally beneath dominion held in another hand.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful work anchors the contrast between the focus's human hands and the later maker.
Emphatic hand-attribution supplies the repeated lexical joint that changes whose work is in view.
Eating anchors the later cattle use back in the focus's beneficiary relation.
Recognition of favor supplies the identical evaluative close shared by both scenes.
Originary creation explicitly frames the animals before work and hands are named.
The repeated purposeful-work branch transfers the focus construction to divine agency.
The repeated hand-attribution marks a deliberate contrast in the subject of making.
Livestock as wealth supplies the created asset that humans subsequently possess and use.
Real possession and disposal affirm delegated control without equating it with origination.
Facilitation after difficulty supplies the enabling relation that makes ownership usable.
Repeated direct consumption makes the cattle sequence a functional reprise of the focus.
Benefit opposed to harm widens provision beyond food while preserving the beneficiary structure.
Consumable wealth joins drinking to eating as another return from the created asset.
The repeated gratitude challenge explicitly evaluates this layered ownership and use.
Hand as effective sovereignty supplies the final scale above all delegated human control.
Dominion supplies the closing ownership frame within which every particular possession is nested.

structural_cues: Verses 36:71-73 repeat the focus cluster of work, hands, eating, and the same gratitude question while adding creation and human ownership.
Verse 36:83 closes the surah by joining hand and dominion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the dense lexical reprise and explicitly affirms human ownership; I infer a contrast between originary making and delegated control. If the focus work-clause is relative rather than negative, the alternative co-production reading survives, but it remains nested under the same higher authorship.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude follows a general contrast between God's gift and things humans make.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude polices a precise hierarchy: people may own, manage, process, and consume, but those valid powers are delegated within a making and dominion they do not possess.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from food consumption to combustion. It remains anchored in the focus eating branch that treats fire as a consumer and in the later green-tree ignition sequence; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy about latent potency, not as a claim that fruit literally denotes fuel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus eating root includes a fire-consumption branch, while fruit names generated benefit.

activation_trace.role: Fire consuming supplied material creates a second kind of eater anchored in the focus verb.
Generated benefit lets plant matter carry more than one latent usable outcome.
The trunked tree supplies the common material source for growth and combustible use.
Fresh green vegetation sharpens the reversal from living moisture to released fire.
Burning fire supplies the hidden energetic yield later drawn from plant matter.
Human ignition supplies a genuine triggering act that releases, but does not originate, the stored potency.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns one-way plant production ending in human eating.
changed_reading.after: The plant can hold several latent yields: humans eat its fruit and can trigger its matter to feed fire, so hand action releases possibilities it did not author.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it renders an ethical response through animal nourishment, milk, and fresh shoots. It remains anchored in multiple focus gratitude branches and is reinforced by grain, benefit, and drink elsewhere in the surah; downstream prose should qualify it as an embodied analogy for manifested response, not a replacement definition of gratitude.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus gratitude root carries images of slight feed becoming visible condition, fullness, and new growth.

activation_trace.role: Small nourishment producing a visible effect supplies the core conversion from reception to response.
Fullness and abundant milk supply an image of received pasture becoming shareable surplus.
Fresh shoots supply an outward sign that nourishment has generated further life.
A seed that germinates and bears grain supplies the surah-level pattern of received potential multiplying.
Concrete benefit supplies the positive effect that gratitude should make visible.
Taking in liquid provision reinforces the embodied reception immediately followed by the repeated gratitude question.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude names a statement made after consuming a benefit.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude can be pictured as metabolizing benefit into visible flourishing and shareable surplus, so the recipient becomes a new site of fruiting.

strongest_changes: The immediate earth-to-fruit chain turns the focus object into the endpoint of hidden, upstream living processes rather than a hand-assembled item.
The command to spend and the later testimony of hands distinguish dependence from passivity: received provision creates distributive and moral responsibility.
The 36:71-73 lexical reprise and 36:83 close establish ownership without originary authorship, nesting human control beneath higher making and dominion.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet did not merely add a broad creation theme. It supplied exact hand, work, eating, ownership, and gratitude reprises that transformed the focus into a layered account of origination, delegated use, accountability, and circulation.
remaining_uncertainties: The polarity or relative force of the focus work-clause remains live, so exclusive non-making and subordinate co-processing should both be carried.
The causal transfer from growth and transport sequences to the focus is a reader inference even though their dependency structures closely align.
The fire-consumption and metabolic-gratitude readings are intentionally exploratory branch analogies and should remain explicitly contained.
